title: Disability Compensation as Recurring Income on a Veterans Pension Award
content:
# Recurring VA disability compensation — Veterans Pension recurring countable income

Recurring compensation in the recurring countable income on a Veterans Pension award follows the veteran's Disability Compensation award — its status, the reason it ended, its rating's monthly rate for a veteran alone and the payments in its payment ledger:

| Disability Compensation award | Recurring compensation counted |
|---|---|
| ended by the veteran's election of pension | none — no compensation recurs |
| ended (terminated) for any other reason | the compensation actually issued in the 12 whole months before — monthly payments and retroactive releases alike |
| otherwise, as while it is running | the monthly rate of its rating for a veteran alone, for 12 months |

## Hypothetical cases

- Award running at a rating whose monthly rate for a veteran alone is 180.42: 180.42 times 12, which is 2165.04.
- Award terminated for a reason other than election of pension, having issued 5 monthly payments of 180.42 and one retroactive release of 900.00 in the 12 whole months before: 902.10 plus 900.00, which is 1802.10.
- Award ended by the veteran's election of pension: 0.
